plot: يعود \\\"الرجل الذي يرفض الموت\\\" إلى المنزل الذي قُتلت فيه عائلته بوحشية خلال الحرب، فيقوم بتفكيكه، ويحمله على شاحنة، عازماً على إعادة بنائه في مكان آمن تكريماً لهم. وعندما يعود قائد الجيش الأحمر الذي قتل عائلته مصمماً على إتمام المهمة، تبدأ مطاردةٌ محمومةٌ ومثيرةٌ عبر البلاد، تنتهي بمعركةٍ حتى الموت.

name: Turbulence 2025
plot: قرر الزوجان الشابان زاك وإيمي القيام برحلة بمنطاد الهواء الساخن فوق جبال الدولوميت الإيطالية لإحياء علاقتهما. وعندما انضمت إليهما جوليا، وهي راكبة ثالثة، برفقة الطيار هاري، تتكشف الأحداث بطرق لم يتخيلوها قط على ارتفاع خمسة آلاف متر في الجو.

name: Lake Rockaway 2025
plot: \\\"بعض البحيرات للسباحة... هذه البحيرة هي مثوى مئات الأرواح البريئة من الشابات.\\\" مرحباً بكم في بحيرة روكاواي، وهي بلدة ريفية صغيرة معزولة احتفظت بالعديد من الأسرار لعقود.

name: Oblivium 2025
plot: كانت سكاي ترغب فقط في تجنب جدتها المنفصلة عنها والمصابة بمرض الزهايمر، ولكن عندما تزورها أخيرًا، تكتشف لغزًا مرعبًا. محاطة بأشباح تختفي من الذاكرة بمجرد أن تغيب عن الأنظار، تجد سكاي وأصدقاؤها أنفسهم عالقين في دوامة مرعبة من أهوال منسية.

name: Wake Up Dead Man- A Knives Out Mystery 2025
plot: عندما يُرسل الكاهن الشاب جود دوبلينتيسي لمساعدة المونسنيور جيفرسون ويكس، ذي الشخصية الكاريزمية والحماسية، يتضح أن الأمور ليست على ما يرام في الكنيسة. فبعد جريمة قتل مفاجئة تبدو مستحيلة تهز المدينة، يدفع غياب مشتبه به واضح رئيسة الشرطة المحلية جيرالدين سكوت إلى التعاون مع المحقق الشهير بينوا بلانك لكشف لغز يتحدى كل منطق.

name: Against All Odds 2025
plot: خلال الاحتلال الياباني لهونغ كونغ عام 1944، كان على فرقة حرب عصابات بقيادة الشيوعيين وعميل سري توحيد مهامهم المتضاربة لإنقاذ طيار من فرقة النمور الطائرة أسقطت طائرته، جيمس، ونجحوا في اختراق حصار ياباني مكثف لتأمين هروبه.

name: Gifted Pain 2025
plot: فيلم \\\"الألم الموهوب\\\" فيلم إثارة عاطفي مليء بالحركة، يستكشف العنف المنزلي والاتجار بالبشر وقوة العقل الباطن الخفية. يروي الفيلم قصة كريستوفر، الشاب المنعزل الذي يعاني من مأساة طفولته. بحثًا عن ملاذ، ينغمس في أفلام فنون القتال حتى بلوغه سن الرشد. لحظة فارقة في حياته تُطلق العنان لقدرات كامنة، تقربه من حل لغز ماضيه. وبينما يشق طريقه في شبكة من الخيانة، باحثًا عن إجابات لماضيه وشياطينه الداخلية التي تطارده.

name: Nuremberg 2025
plot: في ألمانيا ما بعد الحرب، يتعين على طبيب نفسي أمريكي تحديد ما إذا كان سجناء النازيين مؤهلين للمحاكمة بتهمة ارتكاب جرائم حرب، ويجد نفسه في معركة معقدة بين الفكر والأخلاق مع هيرمان غورينغ، الرجل الأيمن لهتلر.

name: Tell Me Softly 2025
plot: كانت كاميلا هاميلتون تظن أن كل شيء تحت سيطرتها... أو هكذا اعتقدت: لم تكن تنوي أن يُقلب الأخوان دي بيانكو عالمها رأسًا على عقب مرة أخرى. قبل سبع سنوات، كان تياغو هو من منحها قبلتها الأولى. وكان تايلور هو من حمى حياتها دائمًا.

name: The Girl In The Woods 2025
plot: يعيش المزارع الأرمل مالكولم غاردنر حياة هادئة قرب غابة منعزلة. عندما تظهر فتاة غامضة تبلغ من العمر عشر سنوات من بين الأشجار، يكشف عن عالم خفي يكمن على مرمى بصره.

name: Tinsel Town 2025
plot: يُخدع بطل أفلام الحركة الهوليوودي المتقاعد ليقوم ببطولة مسرحية عيد الميلاد الفوضوية في بلدة إنجليزية صغيرة، حيث قد يساعده مدرب رقص صريح وابنته المنفصلة عنه على إعادة اكتشاف سحر الموسم.

name: Lost In The Spotlight 2025
plot: على وشك الحصول على دور البطولة في فيلم سيرة ذاتية مرموق، يجد ممثل مشهور نفسه فجأة يفقد كل قدراته التمثيلية.

name: Merv 2025
plot: بعد انفصالهما، يفقد كلبهما المحبوب ميرف حيويته، فيضطر آنا وروس إلى خوض تجربة تربية مشتركة محرجة للغاية. على أمل إخراج ميرف من كآبته، يأخذه روس إلى فلوريدا لقضاء عطلة هم في أمس الحاجة إليها، لكن آنا تظهر فجأة. وبينما يستعيد ميرف حيويته تدريجيًا، يتضح أن مداواة قلب كلبهما المكسور قد يؤدي إلى شرارة حب جديدة بينهما.

name: WorstChristmasEver 2025
plot: ينضم أب مطلق على مضض إلى احتفال زوجته السابقة بعيد الميلاد في أتلانتا من أجل أطفاله، ويلتقي بشكل غير متوقع بشخص قد يساعده على الإيمان بالحب مرة أخرى.

name: Neurovenge 2025
plot: في أعقاب مأساة عائلية، تتطوع مراهقة قوية الإرادة وزوج أمها الحزين لمساعدة شركة تقنية غامضة في تقييم نظام التشغيل الجديد الخاص بها الذي يعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي.

name: Witchy Ways 2024
plot: تترك إيف صخب الحياة وتتجه إلى كوخ لتستعيد ذاتها. وسرعان ما تقع في غرام جارتها الجديدة النشيطة، داني. ومع ازدياد تقاربهما، تعترف داني بأنها ساحرة، لكنها تكشف سرًا غامضًا آخر يهدد بتدمير فرصتهما في الحب.

name: Christy 2025
plot: لم تتخيل كريستي مارتن يومًا حياةً أبعد من جذورها في بلدة صغيرة بولاية فرجينيا الغربية، حتى اكتشفت موهبتها في لكم الآخرين. مدفوعةً بعزيمةٍ وإصرارٍ لا يتزعزع، ورغبةٍ لا تتزعزع في الفوز، اندفعت بقوةٍ إلى عالم الملاكمة تحت إشراف مدربها ومدير أعمالها، جيم. لكن بينما تتباهى كريستي بشخصيتها القوية في الحلبة، تخوض أصعب معاركها خارجها - مواجهةً عائلتها وهويتها، وعلاقةً قد تصبح مصيريةً.

name: Die My Love 2025
plot: تنتقل غريس وشريكها جاكسون إلى منزل ريفي قديم. تسعى غريس وراء حلمها بالكتابة، وسرعان ما يُرزق الزوجان بمولود. لكن مع غياب جاكسون المتكرر، وضغوط الحياة المنزلية التي تُثقل كاهلها، تبدأ غريس بالانهيار، تاركةً وراءها دربًا من الدمار.

name: Keeper 2025
plot: ليز ومالكولم يهربان لقضاء عطلة نهاية أسبوع رومانسية في كوخ منعزل بمناسبة ذكرى زواجهما. عندما يعود مالكولم فجأةً إلى المدينة، تجد ليز نفسها معزولة في حضرة شرّ لا يُوصف يكشف أسرار الكوخ المروّعة.

name: The Carpenters Son 2025
plot: تنفجر قرية نائية في مصر في العصر الروماني في حرب روحية عندما يتم استهداف نجار وزوجته وطفلهما من قبل قوى خارقة للطبيعة.

name: Under The Stars 2025
plot: روائي رومانسي يعاني من علاقة خالية من العاطفة، يذهب إلى إيطاليا بحثًا عن الإلهام، ويجد بشكل غير متوقع فتاة أحلامه.

name: Elmo and Mark Robers Merry Giftmas 2025
plot: يتعاون إلمو وأصدقاؤه في شارع سمسم مع المهندس السابق في وكالة ناسا الذي تحول إلى نجم يوتيوب مارك روبر لصنع هدايا خاصة لتبادلها في عيد الميلاد المجيد.

name: Hunting Jessica Brok 2025
plot: قبل أن تصبح أمًا عزباء في بلدة جنوب أفريقية هادئة، كانت جيسيكا بروك قاتلة ماهرة، شديدة الجرأة، في العمليات الخاصة. ظنت أنها تركت تلك الحياة وراءها. ظنت أن مهمتها الأخيرة المشؤومة هي الأخيرة. لكنها أخطأت في ظنها.

name: Lone Samurai 2025
plot: ساموراي عنيف ومتهور تُحطم سفينته على جزيرة نائية، تاركًا إياه بلا منفذ لغضبه. بعد رحلة روحية لتهدئة أفكاره العدوانية، يجد نفسه مختطفًا من قبل شياطين خارجية تتخذ شكل آكلي لحوم البشر، مما يضع إدراكه للواقع ومواهبه القاتلة على المحك.

name: Pose 2025
plot: يصل فنانان إلى قصرٍ كان يرتاده أفرادٌ من العائلة المالكة، ومعهما خطةٌ مثالية. يلتقط الفنان صورًا عصريةً لألبومها البوب ​​الجديد والأنيق. تبدو عطلة نهاية الأسبوع مثالية، لكن مع وصول المزيد من الناس إلى القصر، تبدأ اللعبة - لعبةٌ نفسيةٌ مثلًا.

name: Car Show Kings 2025
plot: "Car Show Kings" is a captivating urban drama that combines the passion for classic cars, the pursuit of dreams, and the transformative power of love, delivering a thrilling narrative set against the backdrop of Pompano Beach, FL.

name: Frontier Crucible 2025
plot: In 1870s Arizona Territory, a desperately needed wagon full of medical supplies falls victim to an Apache attack. The only man who can guide it through is Merrick Beckford, but in order to get there, he’ll need to enlist the help of a trio of dangerous outlaws hellbent on survival. When they accidentally kill an Apache scout, all bets are off, and survival is the name of the game.

name: Hunting Season 2025
plot: When a reclusive survivalist and his daughter rescue a mysterious, wounded woman from a river, they become entangled in a deadly web of violence and revenge, forcing them to confront a brutal criminal to survive.

name: Jatadhara 2025
plot: Shiva, a rational ghost hunter, man of science and reason—is drawn back to the mystery of a powerful guardian spirit named Dhanapisachi, pulled into a world where his beliefs are tested.

name: Sentimental Value 2025
plot: تلتقي الأختان نورا وأغنيس بوالدهما المنفصل، غوستاف، المخرج الشهير الذي عرض على الممثلة المسرحية نورا دورًا في فيلم يأمل أن يكون عودته إلى الشاشة. عندما ترفض نورا العرض، تكتشف أنه منحها دورها لنجمة هوليوودية شابة متحمسة.

name: The Wrecker 2025
plot: تتحول حياة ميكانيكي سيارات إلى منعطف غير متوقع عندما يتخذ شقيقه المتهور قرارًا سيئًا ويحظى باهتمام غير مرغوب فيه من زعيم الجريمة سيئ السمعة.

name: Directors Cut 2024
plot: A Long Island punk band meets a mysterious director through social media who generously offers to shoot their first music video for free. Desperate for fame, they drive deep into the Pennsylvania woods in hopes of making a killer music video.

name: Man Finds Tape 2025
plot: Pulled in by a series of strange and unexplainable video clips, a brother and sister team up to investigate the events captured in the footage, only to discover a shocking secret that’s overtaking their small-town Texas community.

name: Synthesized 2025
plot: Martyn is a man out of time who loves his wife Valkyrie, computers and synthesizers, which he plays in pubs and clubs to unappreciative audiences. But when Val does him wrong and Martyn's life starts to fall apart he retreats into his music, hoping to calm his inner turmoil.  But music can summon the dark as well as soothe the soul, and it's not long before Martyn is hitting more than just the keys on his synthesizer keyboard.

name: Tendaberry 2024
plot: When her boyfriend returns to Ukraine to care for his ailing father, 23-year-old Dakota must navigate the precarious anxiety of holding onto the past and forging her future in the midst of her South Brooklyn universe.
director: Haley Elizabeth Anderson, Gerardo Coello Escalante

name: Traumatika 2025
plot: Mikey's night terrors become reality when his mother begins showing signs of demonic possession. What he's about to experience will haunt him for the rest of his life and claim countless lives across generations.

name: Predator Wastelands 2025
plot: When an alien hunter arrives on Earth, it takes down a gang of warlords and unexpectedly becomes a folk hero to the oppressed locals. Now, with their support, the alien sets its sights on the warlords' ruthless leader.

name: The Offing 2025
plot: Neviah, a tormented recluse, and Freya, an enigmatic stranger, embark on a scenic road trip that spirals into chaos. Struggling to outrun the past, their friendship is tested at every turn, with all roads leading to a shocking revelation.

name: We Met In December 2025
plot: Two strangers meet on a layover and fall for one another — but forget to exchange numbers. The next day, they fly to Chicago separately, just miss each other, and “embark on separate quests to find one another."

name: Breed Of Greed 2025
plot: The death of a patriarch leads to a scramble for power among his family, leading to some deadly actions.

name: Mirror Life 2025
plot: Amidst a pandemic, a woman documents the search for her cousin who disappeared after entering a clinical trial for an experimental miracle drug called Dumitor.

name: The Blade Cuts Deeper 2024
plot: يرغب الكثيرون في خمس دقائق من الشهرة، لكن بالنسبة للبعض، يأتي ذلك على حساب حياتهم! تعرّفوا على جون أبوت، المُقدّم النرجسي لبرنامج الجريمة الواقعية الشهير \\\"لايتس، كاميرا، كيل\\\". اشتهر البرنامج بإعادة تمثيله المُرعب لأظلم الجرائم، وقد ثريّ باستغلاله الألم والمعاناة. وبينما يتلذذ أبوت بالشهرة بلا خجل، رأى أحد الضحايا ما يكفي. مُنهكًا بفقدانه، يتوق الرجل للانتقام بشدة، والآن يريد أن يُنزف دماء أبوت.

name: The First Snow Of Fraggle Rock 2025
plot: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.

name: Dude 2025
plot: Childhood friends Agan and Kural are inseparable. When Kural encounters romantic troubles, Agan must balance his hidden feelings for her with his desire to ensure her happiness.

name: Jay Kelly 2025
plot: Famous movie actor Jay Kelly embarks on a journey of self-discovery, confronting both his past and present, accompanied by his devoted manager, Ron.

name: Love And Wine 2025
plot: A privileged young man working at his wealthy father's business traps himself in a lie when he falls in love with a hard-working medical student, and tries to convince her that he comes from more humble beginnings like hers. What follows is a comedic whirlwind of chaos and heartfelt revelations.

name: Muzzle- City of Wolves 2025
plot: LAPD officer Jake Rosser endeavors to lead a peaceful life with his family and retired K-9 officer, Socks. However, tranquility dissolves into chaos when a gang targets them in a brutal attack. Alongside his new K-9 partner Argos, Jake launches into a relentless pursuit of justice, determined to protect his loved ones.

name: My Secret Santa 2025
plot: A single mom needs a job. A ski resort needs a Santa. Disguised as a St. Nick lookalike, can Taylor fool a charming hotel heir into ho-ho-hiring her?

name: Oh. What. Fun. 2025
plot: كلير كلوستر هي الرابط الذي يجمع عائلتها المحبوبة والفوضوية معًا في موسم الأعياد. لكن هذا العام، وبعد التخطيط لنزهة خاصة لهم، ارتكبوا خطأً فادحًا وتركوها في المنزل وحيدة. سئمت كلير وشعرت بعدم التقدير، فانطلقت في مغامرة عفوية خاصة بها. وبينما تسارع عائلتها للعثور عليها، تكتشف كلير سحر عيد الميلاد غير المتوقع الذي خرج عن النص.

name: The Age of Disclosure 2025
plot: Director Dan Farah got 34 senior members of the U.S. Government, military, and intelligence community to come on camera. He says they reveal an 80 year cover-up of the existence of non-human intelligent life and a secret war amongst major nations to reverse engineer technology of non-human origin. The film explores the profound impact the situation has on the future of humanity, while providing a look behind-the-scenes with those at the forefront of the bi-partisan disclosure effort.

name: The Night My Dad Saved Christmas 2 2025
plot: When Santa vanishes during a chaotic Christmas, a quirky actor tries to replace him. A father, his teen son and special friends must rescue Santa to save Christmas.

name: Aaryan 2025
plot: A struggling writer announces he'll commit the perfect crime, sparking a tense pursuit as police try to prevent his methodically planned killing spree.

name: Crypto Man 2025
plot: Ok-ja and her son Do-hyun falsely register in Daechi-dong, Seoul, for better schooling despite her limited finances. Do-hyun, envious of his wealthy schoolmate Sang-su for receiving disability benefits, learns that he isn't actually disabled, exposing flaws in government benefits. At university, he and his new friend Ji-woo manipulate government policies for entrepreneurial subsidies, intentionally failing to exploit government leniency. Seeking greater wealth, he embarks on a dubious cryptocurrency venture with investor Kevin, sidelining Ji-woo and enjoying brief success before their scheme crumbles due to regulatory scrutiny. They literally try to make bigger money with bigger money, but end up creating a Death Business.

name: I Wish You Had Told Me 2025
plot: When a young missionary uncovers his late father's long-held secret, he travels from the Philippines to Spain in search of his dad's forbidden love.

name: Lali- Time To Step Up 2025
plot: This documentary follows Lali in her return after four years away from the stage, showcasing the personal journey that led her to become the artist we know today.

name: Lost Horizon 2025
plot: A former soldier, now working for hire, fights to rescue the innocent in a land torn by war. Facing ruthless enemies and betrayal, he struggles for survival, justice, and redemption.

name: Mirrors No. 3 2025
plot: On a weekend trip to the countryside, Laura miraculously survives a car crash. Physically unhurt but deeply shaken, she is taken in by a local woman who witnessed the accident and now cares for Laura with motherly devotion. When her husband and adult son also give up their initial resistance to Laura's presence, the four of them slowly build up some family-like routine. But soon they can no longer ignore their past...

name: Trap House 2025
plot: An undercover DEA agent and his partner embark on a game of cat and mouse with an audacious, and surprising group of thieves - their own rebellious teenagers, who have begun robbing from a dangerous cartel, using their parents' tactics and top-secret intel to do it.

name: Everything to Me 2025
plot: A girl raised in Silicon Valley in the shadow of Steve Jobs' successful return to Apple, and his huge influence on her imagination, her aspirations and relationships.

name: Panopticon 2025
plot: A man working in an office stumbles upon a truth he may not be ready for.

name: Matt Rife- Unwrapped- A Christmas Crowd Work Special 2025
plot: From gifts gone wrong to family tradition fails, Matt Rife turns an unpredictable audience into an unscripted holiday special.

name: In Our Blood 2024
plot: Filmmaker Emily Wyland reunites with estranged mother for documentary. When mother disappears, Emily and cinematographer Danny pursue clues to her whereabouts amidst traces of her past addictions.

name: Bau- Artist at War 2024
plot: Based on the true story of Joseph and Rebecca Bau whose wedding took place in the Plaszow concentration camp during WW2. Using his artistic skills in the camps, Joseph stays alive and helps hundreds to escape. Miraculously, he finds love in the midst of despair. Years later, when called to be a key witness in the trial of the brutal Nazi officer who tortured him and killed his father, Joseph is thrust back into vivid memories of the Holocaust. Now, he calls upon this love and resilience of spirit to face the ultimate demon of his past.

name: American Warrior 2024
plot: A man with a troubled past decides to turn his life around after a heroic act by training for a mixed martial arts tournament.

name: All the Empty Rooms 2025
plot: A journalist and a photographer set out to memorialize the bedrooms left behind by children killed in school shootings.

name: A Newport Christmas 2025
plot: A charitable and spirited Newport socialite in 1905 finds out her father intends for her to become engaged to a man she’s never met at the upcoming Christmas Eve ball. When she wishes for a different life, a man appears — and she somehow time-travels to 2025.

name: Junction 2024
plot: Junction addresses the modern day opioid crisis in America, and asks how did this happen, from three different points of view. The CEO of a pharmaceutical company, a doctor, and a patient.

name: Monsieur Aznavour 2024
plot: From his poor childhood to his rise to fame, from his triumphs to his failures, from Paris to New York, discover the exceptional journey of an artist. Intimate, intense, fragile and indestructible, devoted to his art until the very end, here is one of the most immortal singers of all time: MONSIEUR AZNAVOUR.

name: Live and Die in East LA 2023
plot: After an E.R. doctor treats an injured boy, he is pulled into the world of gangs and street violence in the underbelly of Los Angeles.

name: Lookout 2025
plot: سعيًا وراء السلام بعيدًا عن حياتها المضطربة، تقبل شابة وظيفة مراقبة حرائق في برج برية ناءٍ. وبينما تستقر في وظيفتها الجديدة، تبدأ اضطراباتٌ غريبة وأحداثٌ غريبة بالظهور، وعليها كشف الأسرار المُرعبة التي تُعكّر صفو عزلتها قبل فوات الأوان.

name: Frankenstein- The Anatomy Lesson 2025
plot: Go deep behind the scenes with visionary filmmaker Guillermo del Toro and the "Frankenstein" cast and crew as they give new life to the classic tale.

name: Troll 2 2025
plot: When a dangerous new troll unleashes devastation across their homeland, Nora, Andreas and Major Kris embark on their most perilous mission yet.

name: The Merchants of Joy 2025
plot: In the city that never sleeps, five families hustle each winter to turn sidewalks into holiday outposts.

name: Sugarcane 2025
plot: An investigation into abuse and missing children at an Indian residential school in Canada ignites a reckoning on the nearby Sugarcane Reserve.

name: Girl In The Attic 2025
plot: Kelsey honors her late mother by training for a marathon and sharing her journey online. Her posts attract Billy (Keenan Tracey), a grocery worker caring for his disabled mother, Debbie. Obsessed, Billy kidnaps Kelsey and hides her in their attic, controlling her for years. When Debbie discovers the truth, she and Kelsey must fight for survival.

name: The Running Man 2025
plot: Desperate to save his sick daughter, working-class Ben Richards is convinced by The Running Man's charming but ruthless producer to enter the deadly competition game as a last resort. But Ben's defiance, instincts, and grit turn him into an unexpected fan favorite - and a threat to the entire system. As ratings skyrocket, so does the danger, and Ben must outwit not just the Hunters, but a nation addicted to watching him fall.

name: Stone Creek Killer 2025
plot: A small-town police chief pursues a serial killer, helped by a psychic's visions, while fighting to prove his own innocence.

name: Chris Hemsworth- A Road Trip to Remember 2025
plot: In his most personal documentary yet, Chris Hemsworth turns the camera on his own family after his dad’s recent Alzheimer’s diagnosis. They embark on a road trip into their past, exploring the science of social connection and how it can support memory function. They revisit meaningful places and faces, capturing it all as a home movie, and reviving treasured recollections.

name: Hunting Daze 2024
plot: Nina, a young and headstrong exotic dancer, finds herself stranded in the far North. She convinces her recent customers, five men on a bachelor hunting trip, to put her up for a few days. In this masculine microsociety, by turns hilarious and philosophical, Cynthia starts to feel a sense of belonging she never has before. But a mysterious stranger’s arrival changes the course of this improvised holiday forever. Both raw and dreamlike, Hunting Daze offers up a unique universe where humour, horror, the uncanny, and the sensual combine.

name: LeftHanded Girl 2025
plot: A mother and her two daughters move to Taipei to open a noodle stand at a vibrant night market, but family secrets and tradition test their fresh start.

name: Natale senza Babbo 2025
plot: When Santa Claus, in the midst of an existential crisis, suddenly disappears during the holiday season, his wife Margaret must roll up her sleeves and save the most special day of the year.

name: Reflection In A Dead Diamond 2025
plot: When the mysterious woman in the room next door disappears, a debonair 70-year-old ex-spy living in a luxury hotel on the Côte d'Azur is confronted by the demons and darlings of a lurid past in which moviemaking, memories and madness collide.

name: The Stringer The Man Who Took The Photo 2025
plot: A two-year investigation uncovers a scandal behind the making of one of the most recognized photographs of the 20th century. Five decades of secrets are unraveled in the search for justice for a man known only as  "the stringer."

name: Faster 2025
plot: A former racer returns to the sport through a racing academy, where she meets Will. As they fall for each other, they become rivals competing for the Formula 1 championship, forcing her to choose between love and victory.

name: Now You See Me Now You Dont 2025
plot: The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.

name: The Best You Can 2025
plot: Cynthia Rand is a buttoned-up New Yorker married to a brilliant professor 25 years her senior. She begins feeling the effects of her husband’s advancing age on their relationship, just as her world is turned upside down by the arrival of sharp but chronically underachieving security guard Stan Olszewski in this smart rom-com that reunites Bacon and Sedgwick on screen for the first time in 20 years.

name: The Dam 2025
plot: A woman encounters a man attempting to kill himself.

name: Wildcat 2025
plot: An ex-black ops team reunite to pull off a desperate heist in order to save the life of their leader’s eight-year-old daughter.

name: Jingle Bell Heist 2025
plot: Two down-on-their-luck hourly workers team up to rob a posh London department store on Christmas Eve. Will they steal each other's hearts along the way?

name: Border Hunters 2025
plot: After his police officer brother is killed by a drug dealer who flees to the protection of his cartel-connected uncle in Mexico, an American man with a diverse law enforcement/military background goes south of the border to get revenge

name: Anniversary 2025
plot: When Ellen and Paul’s son introduces his new girlfriend one lovely afternoon at their 25th anniversary party, no one suspects that it is the beginning of the end for this happy family. The new girlfriend is Liz, Ellen’s former student, who left the university, some years before, after Ellen called her out in class for her radical ideology.

name: Blue Moon 2025
plot: On the evening of March 31, 1943, legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart confronts his shattered self-confidence in Sardi’s bar as his former collaborator Richard Rodgers celebrates the opening night of his ground-breaking hit musical “Oklahoma!”.

name: Hideo Kojima Connecting Worlds 2023
plot: A journey into the creative mind of the most iconic video game designer in the world. Featuring appearances from visionary artists Guillermo del Toro, Nicholas Winding Refn, Grimes, George Miller, Norman Reedus, Woodkid, CHVRCHES, this visually captivating documentary gives a rare insight into Hideo Kojima’s creative process as he launches his own independent studio.

name: I Wish You All the Best 2024
plot: A non-binary teen is kicked out of their North Carolina home after coming out to their ultra-religious parents. As a result, they move in with their estranged sister and her husband. Though the two are welcoming, they continue to struggle with anxiety further exacerbated by their parents' rejection. As such, they try to keep a low profile at school. However, after they meet a proudly bisexual classmate, their life begins to look a little more hopeful.

name: Last Days 2025
plot: Determined to fulfill his life’s mission, 26-year-old John Allen Chau embarks on a dangerous adventure across the globe to convert the uncontacted tribe of North Sentinel Island to Christianity, while a detective from the Andaman Islands races to stop him before he does harm to himself or the tribe.

name: RedLife 2023
plot: Som, daughter of a sex worker, believes that love will lead her towards a better life. Ter, a young criminal, robs just to buy love that doesn't exist. Redlife explores a world that is broken, ignored, and which offers no escape.

name: Regretting You 2025
plot: Morgan Grant and her daughter Clara explore what's left behind after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.

name: Kiss Of The Spider Woman 2025
plot: Valentín, a political prisoner, shares a cell with Molina, a window dresser convicted of public indecency. The two form an unlikely bond as Molina recounts the plot of a Hollywood musical starring his favorite silver screen diva, Ingrid Luna.

name: Bugonia 2025
plot: Two conspiracy obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

name: Dining with the Kapoors 2025
plot: This special offers a rare glimpse into the Kapoors, Hindi cinema's first family, over an afternoon of conversation, nostalgia and homemade delicacies.

name: It Was Just an Accident 2025
plot: Vahid, an Azerbaijani auto mechanic, was once imprisoned by Iranian authorities. During his sentence, he was interrogated blindfolded. One day, a man named Eqbal enters his workshop. His prosthetic leg creaks, and Vahid thinks he recognizes one of his former torturers.

name: ONE SHOT with Ed Sheeran 2025
plot: One singer. One city. One shot. Ed Sheeran rocks the streets of New York with his greatest hits in this groundbreaking, real-time music experience.

name: Sangre Del Toro 2025
plot: Director Guillermo del Toro journeys through a labyrinth of childhood memories, cultural myths and monsters to reveal the origins of his visionary films.

name: Altered 2025
plot: In an alternate present, genetically enhanced humans dominate society. Outcasts Leon and Chloe fight for justice against corrupt politicians exploiting genetic disparity, risking everything to challenge the oppressive system.

name: Predator Badlands 2025
plot: Cast out from his clan, a young Predator finds an unlikely ally in a damaged android and embarks on a treacherous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

name: No Other Choice 2025
plot: Looking for a job? When a happy family man is dismissed after twenty-five years of loyal service at a paper company, he finds the perfect solution to land his next role: truly eliminate the competition.

name: Champagne Problems 2025
plot: A driven American exec heads to Paris determined to acquire a champagne brand by Christmas — and accidentally falls for the heir to the bubbly empire.

name: The Shadows Edge 2025
plot: تستعين شرطة ماكاو بضابط الشرطة الخبير في التتبع من التقاعد للمساعدة في القبض على مجموعة خطيرة من اللصوص المحترفين.

name: Homebound 2025
plot: A girl wakes up in her empty childhood home, unaware of how she got there, as she explores the house, small artifacts help her understand why she's there and how to move on.

name: The Family Plan 2 2025
plot: Now that Dan's assassin days are behind him, all he wants for Christmas is quality time with his kids. But when he learns his daughter has her own plans, he books a family trip to London—putting them all in the crosshairs of an unexpected enemy.

name: Train Dreams 2025
plot: A logger leads a life of quiet grace as he experiences love and loss during an era of monumental change in early 20th-century America.

name: Urchin 2025
plot: Mike, a rough sleeper in London, is trapped in a cycle of self-destruction as he attempts to turn his life around. Along the way, he encounters unexpected chances for a fresh start.

name: The Follies 2025
plot: Six women share a common «friend»: madness. It visits us all, pushes us to decide reality, to make daring decisions and to transform our lives.

name: The Son of a Thousand Men 2025
plot: In a small village, a lonely fisherman yearning for a son is drawn to an ethereal light that links him to others and their long-buried secrets.

name: Junkyard Dog 2025
plot: Childhood pals Dog and Mirales live in a little village in the south of France and spend their days just hanging out. To kill time, Mirales has got into the habit of teasing Dog mercilessly. But this summer is different: Dog meets Elsa and romance blossoms.

name: After the Hunt 2025
plot: A college professor finds herself at a personal and professional crossroads when a star pupil levels an accusation against one of her colleagues, and a dark secret from her own past threatens to come to light.

name: If I Had Legs I′d Kick You 2025
plot: With her life crashing down around her, Linda attempts to navigate her child′s mysterious illness, her absent husband, a missing person, and an increasingly hostile relationship with her therapist.

name: Pools 2025
plot: Kennedy has one day to get her shit together or get kicked out of school for good. Instead of buckling down, she rallies a ragtag crew for a midnight pool-hopping adventure through the lavish estates of her college town. But under the surface, Kennedy is searching for answers to the questions tearing her up inside in the wake of her father's death. As the secrets spill, this wild escape becomes a cathartic journey of self-discovery.

name: Selena y Los Dinos: A Familys Legacy 2025
plot: Never-before-seen footage and intimate interviews celebrate the life and legacy of iconic Mexican American singer Selena Quintanilla and her family band.

name: Shelby Oaks 2024
plot: A woman's obsessive search for her missing sister leads her into a terrifying mystery at the hands of an unknown evil.

name: The Senior 2025
plot: At 59, Mike Flynt may be too old to be on a college football field, but not too old to feel the weight of unfinished business. After nearly four decades, he returns to his alma mater to take the hit that changed everything. Bruised, doubted, and nearly broken, he pushes for one more game, not for glory, but for the teammates he lost, the family he fractured, and the ending he still believes is possible.

name: Tell Me What You Want 2024
plot: After his father's death, Eric Zimmerman travels to Spain to oversee his company's branches. In Madrid, he falls for Judith and engage in an intense, erotic relationship full of exploration. However, Eric fears his secret may end their affair.

name: Dog Fugitive 2025
plot: A brutally honest dog psychiatrist, Dr. Fluffy, skips town when her patient is accused of killing their cheating husband and Dr. Fluffy thinks she's to blame.

name: Double Exposure 2025
plot: The past and present mysteriously collide as a struggling artist grapples with guilt over what happened to his first love.

name: Murder At The Embassy 2025
plot: 1934. Private detective Miranda Green investigates a murder perpetrated in the British Embassy in Cairo, where a top secret document was stolen, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world. All those present in this closed place are suspected: the American photographer, the English student, the American actress, the Egyptian security guard, the ambassador interpreter, the Egyptian gardener and - why not? — the Ambassador himself. But who would have expected that a small group of Nazis would be behind a plot, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world?

name: Run 2025
plot: The film follows a boat carrying migrants from various African countries through the Mediterranean sea to Italy. When the boat loses orientation and goes off course, things turn violent as the migrants blame the smugglers. After finally making it to shore, the desperate passengers try to evade police and a few manage to get away.

name: Stolen 2023
plot: The five-month-old baby of impoverished tribal woman Jhumpa Mahato is stolen. Two brothers, Gautam and Raman, who witness the kidnapping, try to help her and become embroiled in the complexities of the investigation.

name: Texas Cult House 2024
plot: High school friends party at the abandoned home of a former cult leader and discover a mysterious anointing oil that holds the secret to the cult’s unraveling. Austin, a gay teen, is haunted by childhood trauma, while his mother (Adrianne Palicki) seeks to redeem the sins of her past.

name: The Correspondent 2024
plot: December 2013, in the shadow of the Great Pyramids of Egypt, Australian journalist Peter Greste is confronted with the brutal realities of reporting from one of the most dangerous cities on earth. Accused of terrorism, Greste becomes a pawn in the middle of a deadly game full of corrupt officials and ancient rivalries – with only his wits keeping him alive.

name: Come See Me In The Good Light 2025
plot: In an intimate and joyful story of love in the face of loss, celebrated poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley find strength—and unexpected hilarity—in what might be their final year together.

name: A Very Jonas Christmas Movie 2025
plot: Kevin, Nick, and Joe Jonas face a series of escalating obstacles as they struggle to make it from London to New York in time to spend Christmas with their families.

name: Lefter- The Story Of The Ordinarius 2025
plot: A football prodigy rises to fame, battling prejudice and inner turmoil on his quest for greatness. Based on the life of Turkish legend, Lefter.

name: Raptus 2025
plot: Faced with the trauma of a brutal sexual assault, young chemistry prodigy Sarah Mathis, grows desperate to expedite her healing process and agrees to an unusual alternative method that involves a new form of artificial intelligence, Raptus.

name: Shark Terror 2025
plot: After falling overboard during a cruise, a young woman washes ashore – injured, stranded, and stalked by sharks – as her desperate mother races to find her.

name: One Battle After Another 2025
plot: يعيش بوب، الثوري الذي انتهى عهده، في حالة من جنون العظمة، ويعيش حياةً بعيدة عن دائرة الكهرباء مع ابنته النشيطة والمعتمدة على نفسها، ويلا. عندما يظهر عدوه اللدود بعد 16 عامًا وتختفي، يهرع الراديكالي السابق للعثور عليها، بينما يُصارع الأب وابنته عواقب ماضيه.

name: A Merry Little Ex-Mas 2025
plot: All Kate and Everett want for Christmas is an amicable divorce and one last holiday as a family, but new flames and old feelings complicate their plans.

name: Being Eddie 2025
plot: From teen comedian to Hollywood legend, Eddie Murphy revisits his extraordinary showbiz ride with raw honesty and humor.

name: Eloá the Hostage- Live on TV 2025
plot: A tragic hostage case from 2008 Brazil unfolds through unseen diary entries, family interviews, and media coverage, as a 15-year-old girl is held captive by her ex-boyfriend for 100 hours while TV networks broadcast it live.

name: Playdate 2025
plot: When out-of-work accountant Brian joins stay-at-home dad Jeff for a playdate with their sons, he expects a laid-back afternoon. Instead, they're chased by mercenaries, and Brian—totally unprepared—must survive one absurd obstacle after another.

name: Popeyes Revenge 2025
plot: The legend of Popeye haunts a group of counsellors as they intend to open a summer camp.

name: Tee Yai- Born To Be Bad 2025
plot: In 1980s Bangkok, two criminals face rough times when a determined detective strains their bond and hunts down an infamous crew of robbers.

name: They Were Witches 2025
plot: Mia, an expert speaker in witchcraft, takes a trip to see a therapist. On the way she meets a group of young people who will begin to die one by one to bring an evil spirit back from death.

name: A Woman Scorned 2025
plot: Jas and her sister Laura are interrupted on their family weekend break in the country side by a group of local men intent on terrorising them. When Laura is attacked and killed by the group, Jas discovers her lifeless body back at the cabin they've hired. She is instilled with grief, rage and fury and intent on hunting down and taking out the gang by whatever means necessary as justice for her sister's murder.

name: Bunker 2025
plot: It charts the fallout when a nuclear threat forces six people into a malfunctioning underground bunker. Tensions soon rise as they fight to stay alive. With oxygen and the trust in each other quickly running out, they learn that a more sinister plan is afoot

name: Grow 2025
plot: In the self-proclaimed ‘Pumpkin Capital of the World’, no-nonsense curmudgeonly farmer Dinah Little takes in her estranged niece Charlie, who decides to enter the local pumpkin growing competition where she and the other growers face fierce competition, sabotage, and a genetically engineered rival.

name: The Unholy 2
plot: Ustadz Qodrat now embarks on the next journey to find his wife, Azizah and once again strike the revenge of evil powers.

name: Roofman 2025
plot: A former Army Ranger and struggling father turns to robbing McDonald’s restaurants by cutting holes in their roofs, earning him the nickname 'Roofman'. After escaping prison, he secretly lives inside a Toys “R” Us for six months, surviving undetected while planning his next move. But when he falls for a divorced mom drawn to his undeniable charm, his double life begins to unravel, setting off a compelling and suspenseful game of cat and mouse as his past closes in.

name: Soul on Fire 2025
plot: After a horrific accident leaves his body scarred, a young boy strives to live and show everyone what is possible with the help of his family, his faith, his community, his longtime idol's kindness, and the entire city of St. Louis.

name: The Beldham 2024
plot: At the edge of postpartum psychosis, new mother Harper moves in with her own mother at their family's rural farmhouse. Soon she finds herself hunted by a threatening monster who has designs on her child.

name: A Bet with the Matchmaker 2023
plot: A relationship columnist on the brink of losing her job takes a bet with a self proclaimed match maker who guarantees to find her perfect match.

name: Adventures in Love & Birding 2025
plot: A single mom agrees to be the partner of a bird enthusiast for a birding competition but misunderstands the assignment and tells everyone she's his new girlfriend instead of just his teammate.

name: Deathstalker 2025
plot: A powerful swordsman known as Deathstalker recovers a cursed amulet from a corpse-strewn battlefield. Marked by dark magic and hunted by monstrous assassins, he must face the rising evil and break the curse.

name: Miami Nights 2026
plot: يخطط الجندي المسرّح ميسون لسرقة ماسة ثمينة لاستعادة زوجته إيف، التي تركته من أجل الثري ريكاردو. يسعى لتجنيد حليفته ليزا غارسيا، لكن الطمع يعقّد خطته الرامية إلى استعادة حب إيف من خلال السرقة.

name: Samsara 2023
plot: Samsara is the Buddhist cycle of death and reincarnation. From the temples of Laos, we will accompany a soul in its transit from one body to another through the bardo.

name: Stone Cold Fox 2025
plot: In this '80s-set revenge story, the defiant Fox breaks out of an abusive commune in search of her family. But when the queenpin kidnaps her little sister and sends a crooked cop after her, Fox has no choice but to infiltrate the very place she escaped.

name: Worldbreaker 2025
plot: Five years ago, a tear in the fabric of reality brought creatures to our world from an alternate dimension bent on our destruction. A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he prepares her for survival and the battles to come. But when the world is about to break, no place is safe.

name: The Negotiator 2025
plot: In a world riven with conflict what is needed to turn war into peace? How can all parties to a war become all parties to a peace? Experience shows it’s the presence of a critical individual in whom all sides can have confidence to chair talks and create the space for an agreement to emerge. In Northern Ireland, one of the few examples of a long-lasting negotiated peace settlement, that critical person was former US Senate Majority Leader, Senator George J Mitchell.

name: Exit Protocol 2025
plot: An assassin whose specialty is killing other assassins trying to get out of the business decides to try to get out himself and must then team up with his former mark to escape the hired killers now gunning for them both.

name: Full Moon 2025
plot: After a wild Full Moon Party in Thailand, the body of a young woman washes ashore, turning the vacation of four Dutch friends into a nightmare.

name: Good Fortune 2025
plot: A well-meaning but rather inept angel named Gabriel meddles in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy capitalist.

name: Mango 2025
plot: An ambitious hotelier and her reluctant daughter take a trip to Málaga, where they find what they've been craving in a farmer's idyllic mango orchard.

name: Meat Kills 2025
plot: Mirthe, a member of the 'Animal Army', secretly films a pig farm's horrors, freeing its children but facing a bloody battle between Nasha's vengeance and the farmer's fury.

name: Vleesdag 2025
plot: ميرثي، أحد أعضاء \\\"جيش الحيوانات\\\"، يصور أهوال مزرعة الخنازير سراً، ويحرر أطفالها لكنه يواجه معركة دامية بين انتقام ناشا وغضب المزارع.

name: Tyler Perrys Finding Joy 2025
plot: جوي، مصممة أزياء ناجحة، تبحث عن عرض زواج في عيد الميلاد. في جبال وايومنغ، تجد ضالتها الحقيقية عندما يعتبرها حبيبها مجرد صديقة.

name: Hippos Revenge 2025
plot: يستعد أب وابنته لافتتاح مشروع إنقاذ سفاري في إنجلترا، حيث تظهر أم فرس نهر وصغيرها. لكن عندما يُدبّر مجرمٌ متوحشٌ خطةً لسرقةهما تحت جنح الليل، تندلع الفوضى.

name: Ice Fall 2025
plot: A young Indigenous game warden arrests an infamous poacher only to discover that the poacher knows the location of a plane carrying millions of dollars that has crashed in a frozen lake. When a group of criminals and dirty cops are alerted to the poacher’s whereabouts, the warden and the poacher team up to fight back and escape across the treacherous lake before the ice melts.

name: In Waves and War 2024
plot: Three Navy SEALs leave their tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan with treatment-resistant, unrelenting psychological pain. They find themselves at the cutting edge of a different frontline: a lifesaving psychedelic therapy that brings healing to a community in urgent need.

name: I Really Love My Husband 2025
plot: When a woman grows disillusioned with her golden-boy husband during their tropical honeymoon, she recruits an enigmatic expat to spice things up—for better or worse.

name: Waltzing with Brando 2025
plot: The story of how Marlon Brando plucked Bernard Judge, an obscure but idealistic Los Angeles architect from his stable existence and convinced him that he should build the world’s first ecologically perfect retreat on a tiny and uninhabitable Tahitian island.

name: Black Phone 2 2025
plot: Four years after escaping The Grabber, Finney Blake is struggling with his life after captivity. When his sister Gwen begins receiving calls in her dreams from the black phone and seeing disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp, the siblings become determined to solve the mystery and confront a killer who has grown more powerful in death and more significant to them than either could imagine.
